comment.text: ZNF623 T500 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting ZNF623 residue T500 have been observed in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma and lung adenocarcinoma.
